messages:
Ava (Marketing Lead): Quick sync — finalizing green room sims for next Wed webinar. Need mic checks, demo failovers, and clear audience routing. who can take lead on the run-through schedule?
Diego (Speaker Ops): I can own scheduling. propose 3x 30-min green-room sims in the week prior. slots at M/W/F 10am PT. thoughts? :calendar:
Sam (Product): That works. Can we reserve the first slot for the core demo team + host + 1 backup speaker? want to validate the fallback path if the model latency spikes.
Priya (Demo Engineer): yup — I'll be in the first two. Need +15m after the second slot to rehearse the failover flow: swap to smaller model + canned responses. I'll share the commands.
Priya (Demo Engineer): demo failover snippet (for ops):
```
# switch to fallback model
curl -X POST https://redwood.example/api/switch -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","reason":"demo-fallback"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# route traffic to backup region
curl -X POST https://redwood.example/api/route -d '{"region":"us-west-2"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Jordan (Host): Great — for audience routing: we'll split Q&A into 10m live + 15m follow-up (collect email for deeper tech answers). Marketing can surface a form link in chat.
Ava (Marketing Lead): I'll prepare the chat CTA and short form. Diego — can you ensure speakers have the form link and fallback talking points?
Diego (Speaker Ops): yes. I'll DM each speaker with: 1) the form link 2) 3 bullet fallback points 3) phone dial-in (in case of A/V).
Sam (Product): Also signal to eng on-call the rehearsal times so they can standby. Deploy-bot, please post rehearsal windows to #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: Posted: rehearsal windows scheduled M/W/F 10:00-10:30 PT (green room sim), 10:30-10:45 PT (failover dry-run) — ping @eng-oncall.
Ava (Marketing Lead): Perfect. One more ask: audience segmentation during sign-up — can marketing tag registrants as 'benchmarks', 'integration', or 'general'? we want to route leads post-webinar.
Sam (Product): yes, tag field is ready in the form. We'll wire tags into the inbound routing rules in HubSpot. Diego, please flag follow-ups by tag.
Priya (Demo Engineer): For tech dry-run please ensure low-latency test vector is included: long-context (>1k tokens) + streaming enabled. That reproduces prod tail latency.
Diego (Speaker Ops): noted. I'll add that to the rehearsal checklist.
Ava (Marketing Lead): timeline: confirm speakers by EOD Friday, finalize CTA + form by Monday, rehearsals scheduled next week. If any conflicts, speak up now. :100:
Jordan (Host): I'll prep the host script with a 60s handoff to demo and a 20s contingency script if demo is down.
Sam (Product): linking the fallback runbook here: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/webinar-fallback — please review before the first sim.
Ava (Marketing Lead): thanks all — Diego, ping when you DM'd speakers so we can close the loop.
Diego (Speaker Ops): Will do. Starting outreach now.
Priya (Demo Engineer): I'll drop the rehearsal checklist into the green-room folder and add the failover playbook.
Ava (Marketing Lead): closing — see you in the green room. :raised_hands:
